About this summary
This summary sets out the key features of the Essentials Select scheme proposed for Demo
Organisation Ltd. It does not contain the full terms of the scheme, which are set out in the
scheme rules. In the event of any diﬀerence between this summary and the scheme rules, the
scheme rules will apply.
Throughout this summary, "we", "us" and "our" mean NorthStar Health plc, and "you" and
"your" mean the person covered under the scheme.
Section 1 - Key terms
The following terms have the meanings given below wherever they appear in this summary.
Covered person - an employee or a dependant who has been accepted for cover under the
scheme.
Employee - a person employed by the company on a permanent contract, or on a ﬁxed-term
contract with an original duration of at least six months.
Dependant - an employee's spouse or partner, and their children up to the age of 21.
Scheme year - each period of twelve months beginning on the scheme start date or on a
renewal date.
Eligible treatment - treatment of an acute condition that is medically necessary, carried out by
a recognised practitioner and, where required, authorised by us in advance.

Recognised practitioner - a specialist, GP, therapist or counsellor who meets our
professional and registration standards.
Self-referral - accessing a therapy without a referral from a GP or specialist.

Beneﬁt limits apply to each covered person and are reset at the start of each scheme year.
Section 3 - Who can be covered
The scheme is open to all employees of Demo Organisation Ltd who are resident in the United
Kingdom or the Republic of Ireland. There is no minimum period of service before an
employee can join, and cover is not restricted by grade or job role.
Contractors, consultants engaged through a service company, and agency workers are not
employees for the purposes of the scheme and cannot be covered.
New employees may join from their ﬁrst day of employment. Employees who do not join when
ﬁrst eligible may join at the next renewal date.
Section 4 - Dependants
Employees may apply to add their spouse or partner and their children to the scheme.
Dependants may be added at the discretion of the scheme administrator. Arrangements for the
NorthStar Health | Essentials Select | Company Healthcare Scheme
Page 2 of 5

cost of dependant cover, including whether any contribution will be required from the
employee, will be conﬁrmed at renewal.
Children can remain on the scheme until the renewal date following their 21st birthday.
Section 5 - Your premium and excess
The annual premium for the scheme is £108,000, payable annually in advance on the scheme
start date and on each renewal date. The premium includes insurance premium tax at the
prevailing rate.
An excess of £150 applies to each covered person once in each scheme year. The excess
applies to all claims under the scheme, including claims for cancer care, and is deducted from
the ﬁrst claim made in the scheme year.
Section 6 - Hospital, out-patient and diagnostic cover
Hospital treatment
Eligible in-patient and day-patient treatment is covered in full at hospitals in the NorthStar
Select network. This includes accommodation, nursing, theatre costs, drugs and dressings,
and the fees of the specialist and anaesthetist.
If you choose to be treated at a hospital outside the NorthStar Select network, you must obtain
our approval before treatment, and we may limit the amount we pay to the cost of treatment at
an equivalent network hospital.
Out-patient consultations and diagnostics
Out-patient consultations with a specialist, together with diagnostic tests and scans, are
covered in full following a referral from a GP or from the NorthStar digital GP service.
Section 7 - Cancer care
We cover eligible cancer treatment in full, including surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy and
biological therapies, together with the diagnostic tests and consultations needed to diagnose
and plan the treatment.
Drugs that are experimental, or that are not licensed for use in the United Kingdom for the
condition being treated, are not covered.
Monitoring consultations and tests are covered for up to ﬁve years after active treatment has
ended. Palliative care is covered where it is provided in a hospital or hospice in the NorthStar
Select network.
NorthStar Health | Essentials Select | Company Healthcare Scheme
Page 3 of 5

Section 8 - Therapies
Physiotherapy is covered for up to ten sessions per covered person in each scheme year
when you have been referred by a GP or specialist.
You may also access physiotherapy by self-referral through the NorthStar member app. Where
you self-refer, cover is limited to six sessions in each scheme year, and any further sessions
will only be covered following a referral from a GP or specialist. Sessions accessed by self-
referral count towards the overall limit of ten sessions.
Osteopathy and chiropractic treatment are not covered under this scheme.
Section 9 - Mental health
Mental health treatment is covered in full. This includes out-patient therapy and counselling,
psychiatric consultations, and in-patient and day-patient treatment.
Out-patient therapy is subject to a clinical review after every twelve sessions. Further sessions
will be authorised where the review conﬁrms that treatment remains clinically appropriate.
Section 10 - Underwriting
The scheme is underwritten on a continued personal medical exclusions (CPME) basis.
Employees transferring from the company's existing scheme will keep any personal exclusions
that applied under that scheme.
New members joining after the scheme start date are covered on a moratorium basis.
Conditions for which a new member has had symptoms, treatment or advice in the ﬁve years
before joining are excluded until the member has completed one continuous year of cover
without symptoms, treatment or advice for that condition.
Section 11 - Exclusions
The scheme does not cover:
•  treatment of chronic conditions, beyond the initial diagnosis and stabilisation of an acute
ﬂare-up;
•  cosmetic treatment, unless it is needed as a direct result of an accident covered by the
scheme;
•  normal pregnancy and childbirth;
•  routine dental treatment and optical care;
NorthStar Health | Essentials Select | Company Healthcare Scheme
Page 4 of 5

•  experimental or unlicensed drugs and treatments;
•  treatment received outside the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland;
•  treatment for addiction or for self-inﬂicted injury;
•  osteopathy and chiropractic treatment.
Section 12 - How to claim
Claims can be made through the NorthStar member app or by calling 0800 555 0199.
Treatment should be authorised before it takes place, and we will tell you which hospitals and
practitioners you can use.
Invoices must be submitted within three months of the date of treatment. Invoices received
after this time may not be paid.
Section 13 - Complaints
If you wish to make a complaint, please write to NorthStar Health Complaints, 22 Meridian
Way, Leeds LS1 4ZZ, or email complaints@northstar-health.example. If you are not satisﬁed
with our ﬁnal response, you may be able to refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman
Service.
Section 14 - General
The company must notify us of employees joining and leaving the scheme within 30 days.
Cover for a covered person ends on the date the employee leaves the company's
employment.
This summary is governed by the law of England and Wales.
